text:
Zoe: Heads-up: starting a canonicalization pass on the promptset ahead of new-model bring-up. Goal: normalize near-duplicates, resolve tokenizer split mismatches, and produce a 250-item micro-golden for early quant/regression checks.

Camille: Nice. What normalization rules are you using?

Zoe: Rules: 1) lowercase-norm for natural text except code blocks, 2) collapse repeated whitespace and punctuation, 3) normalize unicode to NFKC, 4) canonicalize date/number formats to ISO where detected. We'll keep original raw_text in provenance.

Diego: For dedupe: using simhash + embed cosine. Remove items with simhash_match AND cosine >= 0.92. Important: if either item has an existing gold label, do not drop — instead mark as potential-duplicate for adjudication.

Priya: Tokenizer mismatches have bitten us before. Are we snapshotting tokenizer outputs for v1 and v2?

Zoe: Yes. We'll store tokenized sequences for tokenizers v1.3 and v2.0 under s3://redwood-token-snaps/canonical/1784043210/. That helps when comparing quantization artifacts across tokenizers.

Alex: How big is the candidate pool for the pass?

Zoe: Candidate pool ~18k after preliminary filters. We'll sample 4k for manual triage and create the micro-golden of 250 from high-risk / high-disagreement buckets.

Camille: Sampling command?

Zoe: Putting exact command here for reproducibility:

```
tools/canonicalize_sample.sh \
  --input s3://seedbanks/promptset_master/2025-01-01.jsonl \
  --out s3://redwood-pruned/canonical/1784043210.jsonl \
  --norm unicode,nl,spaces,dates \
  --dedupe simhash,embed \
  --embed-model embed-medium-v2 \
  --simhash-threshold 0.85 \
  --cosine-threshold 0.92 \
  --sample 4000 \
  --micro-golden 250
```
Noor: Labelers will need a triage UI view that shows both raw and canonicalized text side-by-side, plus token counts for both tokenizers. Can we add that?

Zoe: Yes — wiring the UI now. Landing path for label jobs: s3://redwood-label-jobs/canonicalize/1784043210/. Each record includes: id, raw_text, canon_text, simhash, embed_hash, tok_v1, tok_v2, provenance_url.

labeler-bot: queue update: pending_jobs=2, running=4, avg_per_item=6m; workers_online=[Noor, Talia, Ben, Priya].

SRE: Note: canonicalize run will kick off an AWS batch job that uses ephemeral EBS for tokenization cache. If you need GPU for embed extraction, request q-embed pool. Otherwise CPU-only is fine.

Diego: For adjudication: use 3 labeler votes, mark disagreements where top labels differ >1 category. Any item with >=2 votes for gold_bad goes to senior-adjudicator.

Priya: Micro-golden composition suggestion: 60 long-context (>512 tokens), 60 code/cli, 60 ambiguous intent, 40 multilingual (nonlatin scripts), and 30 high-risk PI/PHI patterns. Keep 50 adversarial probes sprinkled.

Alex: Important: snapshot embeddings and token counts at pick time to s3://redwood-embeds/canonical/1784043210/ so eval harness can re-run deterministic comparisons across quant levels.

Zoe: Done — embed snapshot is included. Also tagging each item with tokenizer_version and embed_model_version in metadata.

Noor: For quant checks: request that QA run quick smokes on the micro-golden with baseline fp16 and quant int8, int4 from the quant-experiments branch. Capture exact model sha.

Camille: Also add a run with the reranker enabled vs disabled for a small subset (50 items) to see ranking differences.

Zoe: Will include reranker ON/OFF run in the eval matrix.

labeler-bot: job created=1, uploaded_items=4000, micro_golden_candidates=250

Diego: Timeline: canary triage (500) -> adjudicate (24h) -> freeze 250 micro-golden -> run quant smokes (2 GPUs) -> full label sweep of remaining 3500 in batches.

Priya: I can coordinate labeling schedule. We should prioritize multilingual and long-context first.

SRE: AWS batch job id=batch-178404A created; logs: https://batch-logs.internal/batch-178404A. EBS mount path /var/cache/tokenize.

Zoe: Action items:
- SRE: monitor batch logs + share status (in progress)
- Labelers: Noor/Talia/Ben/Priya start canary (500) tomorrow AM
- Diego: prepare adjudication rubric and senior-adjudicator list
- Alex: ensure embed/token snapshots are versioned and visible to eval harness
- Camille: set up reranker ON/OFF eval config
- Zoe: post micro-golden freeze and tag model-branch used

Camille: Thanks — ping in this thread if any blockers. :rocket:
